title: Fall Detection (Wrist-worn)
description: Detect falls in less active individuals, such as elderly people, using a wrist-worn accelerometer.
long_description: This project provides a DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model that detects falls using a 3-axis accelerometer worn on the wrist. The model is paired with a stillness-based post-processing gate that confirms a fall after a period of inactivity, reducing false positives. Wearable testing measured 93.3% sensitivity with 1.8-2.25 false positives per user per week.
